title: Lane lint parses each changed Python file at the version CI pins
why: On #1973 a builder wrote a nested same-quote f-string (merge/merge.py:331), which only Python 3.12 and later accept. CI pins 3.11; local tests on 3.13 passed, and the round-2 reviewer caught it only by running python3.11 by hand (lane lint-uses-pinned-tools, 07:24 CST Nov 8).
note: Done check: a red test where lane lint fails a changed .py file that the interpreter CI pins (python3.11 today, read from the CI pin, not a copied number) cannot parse, and a control where 3.11-valid code passes. Measured (lane, 07:30 CST Nov 8): `ast.parse(..., feature_version=(3,11))` under Python 3.13 exits 0 on the unfixed merge/merge.py; only a real python3.11 parse fails ("f-string: expecting '}'"). So the check runs the pinned interpreter, not the flag. A fix for a found gap (item 410 a). Slug from the lane; title by triage.
